description: Source code implementing batching operations for tensors in PyTorch, including functions to add, remove, and manipulate batch dimensions within batched tensor objects.

methods.name: _add_batch_dim
methods.description: Adds a batch dimension to the tensor `self` out-of-place.

methods.name: has_level
methods.description: Checks if a tensor has a batch dimension at a specific level.

methods.name: remove_existing_batch_dim
methods.description: Removes a batch dimension at a specified level from a batched tensor, returning the tensor without that batch dimension and its index.

methods.name: maybe_movedim
methods.description: Moves a tensor dimension if needed, or returns the original tensor if source and destination are the same.

methods.name: _remove_batch_dim
methods.description: Removes or adds a batch dimension at a specified level, adjusting tensor shape accordingly.
